# DuskRoute

> DuskRoute is a happy-hour discovery service for Australian cities. Find pub and bar deals for after-work drinks or an evening out — by region, suburb, map, or near you.

DuskRoute (https://duskroute.com) lists structured happy hour and specials data for venues. Sydney is live; other Australian cities are planned.

URL patterns:

- Region deal list: https://duskroute.com/{region} (e.g. /sydney)
- Suburb deal list: https://duskroute.com/{suburb-slug}-{postcode} (e.g. /surry-hills-2010)
- Venue page: https://duskroute.com/{suburb-slug}/{venue-slug}

Use the sitemap for exhaustive region, suburb, and venue URLs. Account, favourites, report, and admin paths are personal or internal and are not needed to understand the product.

## Core

- [Home](https://duskroute.com/): Choose a region or find deals near you
- [About](https://duskroute.com/about): What DuskRoute is and who it is for
- [Map search](https://duskroute.com/map): Browse deals on a map
- [Near me](https://duskroute.com/nearby): Deals near your current location
- [Venue search](https://duskroute.com/venue-search): Search venues by name
- [All suburbs](https://duskroute.com/all-suburbs): Directory of suburbs with deals

## Regions

- [Sydney](https://duskroute.com/sydney): Happy hour deals across Sydney
- [Sydney suburbs](https://duskroute.com/sydney/all-suburbs): Suburb directory for Sydney

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://duskroute.com/privacy): How DuskRoute collects, uses, and stores data
- [Terms of service](https://duskroute.com/tos): Terms for using duskroute.com
- [Contact](https://duskroute.com/contact): Support and venue contact emails

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://duskroute.com/sitemap.xml): Index of region, suburb, venue, and static sitemaps
- [Robots](https://duskroute.com/robots.txt): Crawl allow/disallow rules

## Optional

- [Sydney statistics](https://duskroute.com/sydney/statistics): Shareable Sydney happy hour infographic — densest suburbs, busiest days, and what's on offer
- [Sydney analytics](https://duskroute.com/sydney/analytics): Region analytics for Sydney
- [Log in](https://duskroute.com/login): Sign in to save favourites and manage contributions
